newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HANSA INVESTMENT APPLICATION REJECTED AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: HANSA INVESTMENT APPLICATION REJECTED AGAIN.

text.p: Lithuania's securities commission said on Friday that it had again rejected an application by Hansa Investments to operate in the country as an investment management and consulting firm.

"Some provisions of Hansa Investments' by-laws did not meet the regulations of the securities commission," Irma Lazickiene, the head of the investment company department with the commission, told Reuters.
It is the second time that the company, a sister firm of Estonia's Hansapank, has been rejected by the commission.
Hansa Investments is the first foreign investment management and consulting company to apply to set up shop in Lithuania.
"We have no doubt that permission for Hansa Investment will be issued when its by-laws are amended," Lazickiene said.
"The securities comission has little practice in dealing with such issues and the procedures take time," she added.
